t: Pair of Forge Steel saw horses constructed from durable polypropylene, and designed to provide a stable and reliable work platform for various cutting tasks. The robust work supports are ideal for carpentry, joinery, and general construction, offering essential stability when cutting timber, boards, and other materials. Featuring integrated rubberised feet to enhance stability and prevent slippage. The 2-pack offers a combined maximum load capacity of 350kg, ideal for providing support for heavy-duty work in busy workshops or building sites.
